facts.text: Caroline expressed gratitude towards Melanie and acknowledged the support network that has been present throughout her transition, providing love, guidance, and acceptance.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Melanie! This support network has been amazing. They've been there for me every step of the way giving me love, guidance, and acceptance. I couldn't have done it without them.
I'm so lucky to have such a great support system around me. Their love and encouragement has really helped me accept and grow into my true self. They've been instrumental in my transition.

facts.text: Caroline mentioned that her friends and family have been actively involved in helping her with her transition, and that their support has made a significant difference.

evidence.quote: It's made me appreciate how lucky I am to have my friends and family helping with my transition. They make all the difference.
How have your friends and fam been helping you out with your transition?

facts.text: Melanie responded positively to Caroline's gratitude, emphasizing the importance of unconditional love and shared a photo of her family camping at the beach.

evidence.quote: Glad you have support, Caroline! Unconditional love is so important.
Here's a pic of my family camping at the beach. We love it, it brings us closer! [image: a photo of a family sitting around a campfire on the beach]
